Library: risk_management

Purpose: Enforce risk constraints (position sizing, exposure limits, validation).

Key Modules:
- risk_manager.py: High-level risk checks and orchestration.
- position_validator.py: Validates new positions against limits.
- exposure_calculator.py: Computes exposure metrics.

CLI (cli.py):
- Entrypoint: `python -m backend.src.lib.risk_management.cli`
- Flags: `--help`, `--version`, `--format json|text`
- Commands: `validate-position`, `calculate-exposure`

Data Contracts:
- RiskParameters (backend/src/models/risk_parameters.py)
- TradingSignal (backend/src/models/trading_signal.py)

Notes:
- Validators raise on invalid configuration; probability edge range typically [0.01, 0.20].
